Description: A bill to amend the Commodity Exchange Act to strengthen the regulation of futures trading, to require public disclosure of certain information relating to sales of commodities, to bring all agricultural and other commodities traded on exchanges under regulation and for other purposes.
To repeal the Silver Purchase Act of 1934, and for other purposes
To amend title II of the Social Security Act to provide that full benefits (when based upon the attainment of retirement age) will be payable to men at age 60 and to women at age 55

A bill to authorize the Secretary of Agriculture to transfer certain funds to enable the Secretary to take immediate action to eradicate and control avian influenza and citrus canker, and for other purposes.
A bill to amend the Act entitled An act to authorize the sale of certain public lands in Alaska to the Catholic Bishop of Northern Alaska for use as a mission school, approved August 8, 1953.
